title: Marvell bets $115 billion that AI's next bottleneck is light
short:
Marvell is buying laser maker Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal.
The bet: AI's next bottleneck is light.
Full story: https://badeifer.github.io/news/marvell-lumentum-115-billion-optics/
#AI #Semiconductors #DataCenters #Marvell
x: Marvell is buying Lumentum in an all-stock deal worth $115B including debt. It owes $5.8B if it walks away, $3.2B if regulators block it. Close expected in the first half of 2028. https://badeifer.github.io/news/marvell-lumentum-115-billion-optics/

Marvell is buying the laser maker Lumentum in an all-stock deal worth $115 billion including debt, about $1,132 per Lumentum share. Closing is expected in the first half of 2028.

The bet is that the parts moving data between AI chips now matter almost as much as the chips. The termination fees, $5.8 billion if Marvell walks and $3.2 billion if regulators block the deal, show who carries the risk. https://badeifer.github.io/news/marvell-lumentum-115-billion-optics/
